name: labor
doc:
LABOR - wages under the statute, sealed (issue #11, 2026-10-16: reach, down the domain list). Through
labor.LABOR_VERIFY: gross pay, the FLSA time-and-a-half week, the 2080-hour year both ways (salary to hourly,
hourly to salary), take-home at a flat rate, and the federal minimum wage - a compliant wage sealed compliant and
a wage below the floor sealed non-compliant (claimed false). The statute's numbers are CITED as postulates; the
pay arithmetic is SEALED to the cent. Idempotent.

sticks.question: Labor - wages, overtime and the minimum, sealed
sticks.statement: Pay is arithmetic over a rate, hours and the statute's multipliers: gross, time and a half past forty, the 2080-hour year, and a floor the rate must meet.
references: Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938, 29 U.S.C. section 206 (minimum wage) and section 207 (overtime)
U.S. Office of Personnel Management: 2,087 and 2,080 hours as the work-year conventions

marks.claim: [gross pay, SEALED] $18.50 x 45 h = $832.50 (sealed through labor.LABOR_VERIFY) - the straight product, before the statute touches it.

[the FLSA week, SEALED] 40 h at $18.50 plus 5 h at 1.5 x $18.50: $740.00 + $138.75 = $878.75 (sealed through labor.LABOR_VERIFY; 29 U.S.C. 207). The forty-first hour costs the employer half again as much - the premium is the law's lever against the long week.
[the premium alone, SEALED] Ten overtime hours at $10 pay $150 (sealed through labor.LABOR_VERIFY): 1.5 x 10 x 10.
[salary to hourly, SEALED] $52,000 a year is $25.00 an hour (sealed through labor.LABOR_VERIFY): 52 weeks x 40 hours = 2080.
[hourly to salary, SEALED] $20 an hour is $41,600 a year (sealed through labor.LABOR_VERIFY): the same 2080, the mirror direction.

[take-home at a flat rate, SEALED] $1000 gross at a 28 percent total rate leaves $720 (sealed through labor.LABOR_VERIFY). A flat rate is a model of withholding; real brackets are the tax code's, declined here.
[the floor met, SEALED] $7.25 an hour meets the federal minimum of $7.25 (sealed through labor.LABOR_VERIFY): the floor is inclusive.

[the floor missed, SEALED AS NON-COMPLIANT] $7.00 does not - sealed with claimed_compliant = false (sealed through labor.LABOR_VERIFY). A quarter under the statute is under the statute; the engine seals the negative as a negative.

[the statute, CITED] Time and a half past forty hours (29 U.S.C. 207) and $7.25 (29 U.S.C. 206, since 2009) are LAW, not theorems - chosen by Congress, changeable by Congress, exceeded by many states; cited as postulates. The 2080-hour year is a convention (OPM also uses 2,087); the flat tax rate is a simplification. What is sealed is the arithmetic each one commands.
marks.source: 29 U.S.C. 206, 207; U.S. OPM fact sheet on the 2,087-hour year

marks.claim: [on the one map] Wages are the economics floor's price of labour (card_floor_economics) bounded by statute (the law stick: a rule with a citation, applied exactly). The engine seals the pay a rule produces and declines what the rule should be.
marks.source: the one map; card_floor_economics; the law stick
